title: SHAPE GEOMETRY golden-parity regression
description: RESOLVED. Root cause: commit 035796d (fill0/fill1 closed-loop reconstruction in convertShape) makes the FLA importer emit a filled+stroked region as TWO separate closed paths (fill-only + identical stroke-only). The SWF encoder wrote each as its own DefineShape loop, doubling the edge-record count vs Flash's single combined fill+stroke loop, so record-signature match failed for 3 shapes (gradient work 2b3ae69 was NOT the cause). Fix: packages/swf/src/shapes.ts coalesceFillStrokePairs() merges an adjacent fill-only + byte-identical stroke-only pair into one combined loop. 2 shapes record-match; the 3rd (rounded-rect button face) is the documented gradient-fill expansion -> tools/golden-parity.mjs bounds-matches it and reports KNOWN-GAP. VERIFY: node tools/golden-parity.mjs -> exit 0; all hard dims PASS. @flash/swf 108 files/1369 tests pass (3 new tests). @flash/core 327/330 (3 fails = missing fixtures/flash8-empty.fla, task 1207). Docs updated.
